import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors1 = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(breed_counts.index[::-1], breed_counts.values[::-1], color=colors1[::-1])
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)
for bar, val in zip(bars1, breed_counts.values[::-1]):
    ax1.text(val + 100, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:,}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out missing values and sort by age
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0) & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20)]
sns.histplot(data=age_data, x='AlterVHundNum', bins=20, ax=ax2, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data["AlterVHundNum"].mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend(fontsize=10)

# 3. Dog Gender Distribution by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Get registrations by district and gender
district_gender = df.groupby(['KreisLang', 'SexHundLang']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
# Sort by total registrations
district_gender['Total'] = district_gender.sum(axis=1)
district_gender = district_gender.sort_values('Total', ascending=True).drop('Total', axis=1).tail(12)

district_gender.plot(kind='barh', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('')
ax3.set_title('Dog Registrations by District and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Dog Gender', loc='lower right', fontsize=9)
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)

# 4. Trend of Dog Registrations Over Years
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
yearly_trend = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr').size()
ax4.plot(yearly_trend.index, yearly_trend.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
         markersize=8, color='#2E86AB', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2)
ax4.fill_between(yearly_trend.index, yearly_trend.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax4.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Registration Trend Over Years', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax4.set_xticks(yearly_trend.index)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add data labels for trend
for x, y in zip(yearly_trend.index, yearly_trend.values):
    ax4.annotate(f'{y:,}', (x, y), textcoords="offset points", 
                xytext=(0, 10), ha='center', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
